title: Two more ways to make images
summary:
The project directory gained a wearable image app, an image-generation interface, and an MCP server listing, while ad translation got better at leaving English alone.

The project directory added CitizenOneX’s Frame wearable app, which turns voice prompts into images users can save or share, and @altkriz’s Imagen web interface for generating with flux and turbo. Both are community projects newly listed, not newly built in these PRs.

@voodoohop’s MCPollinations was added to the SDK and Libraries listings. The existing MCP server lets AI assistants use Pollinations for image, text, and audio generation; this change makes it easier to find.

Affiliate ad translation now checks the full content for its language instead of relying on a short sample or the last message. That helps preserve the original wording of English ads. DreamGF was also added as an AI companion affiliate.

highlights.title: Find MCPollinations
highlights.text: MCPollinations is now listed among the community libraries. Its MCP server lets AI assistants generate images, text, and audio through Pollinations. [Explore community projects](https://pollinations.ai).
